content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to working with [product_name] and experimenting with its features. I have a question I can't resolve on my own, so I hope someone here can provide guidance. I'm using a [product_name] [version_no], which is connected to a lighting DMX controller in my network. I am able to activate the controller through port 7000 using the TCP protocol, by sending commands like ‘pb01/in=100’. Now, I'm trying to find out if [product_name] can transmit such messages, but I'm unsure about how to achieve this. Is this possible? If so, what steps do I need to take? Any assistance would be appreciated.
[product_name] supports only Modbus TCP protocol. For this functionality, you may need a [product_name] [version_no].
[product_name] can communicate using: - Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 protocol. - Modbus TCP/IP.
